memory_candidates: BracketFormula with shared pos_pt (constant disjunction pointType) is strictly weaker than per-SSN pointTypes. IntervalPattern.holds with constant pointType only requires each witness to satisfy SOME disjunct, not a specific one. This breaks the forward direction when k > 1. Counter-example: model where all points in interval have identical predicates — k witnesses all match the same SSN. Fix: add explicit per-SSN existence conditions alongside bracket.
